description: Returns all non-deleted pages of a collection (the full sidebar tree, flat) with id, name, urlName, type, parentId, child (ordered child ids), state, isPublished, meta, sharingMeta and the endpoint requestType for endpoint pages. Page types: 0 invisible root, 1 parent page/module (top-level), 3 subpage, 4 API endpoint, 5 example/sample request of an endpoint. States: 0 pending, 1 draft, 2 approved/published, 3 rejected. Use it to find pageIds and the hierarchy. Collection must belong to the caller's org. GET https://api.docstar.io/orgs/:orgId/collection/:collectionId/pages
name: list_collection_pages
